57: ## Engineering constitution (non-negotiable)
58: 
59: These rules override convenience. Treat them as a gate before saying "done".
60: 
61: ### 1. TypeScript — do not silence the type system
62: 
63: - **Do NOT use `any` to bypass type errors.** Not `: any`, not `as any`, not `@ts-ignore`, not `@ts-nocheck`, not `@ts-expect-error` without a written justification. `any` propagates silently and defeats the only compile-time safety net this project has.
64: - When a type error appears, fix the root cause:
65:   - Missing / wrong library types → install `@types/...`, or narrow the import, or write a precise `interface` / `type` for the shape you actually use.
66:   - Shape is genuinely unknown at the boundary (JSON from an API, `postMessage` payload, `window.*` injection) → type it as `unknown` and narrow with a type guard (`typeof`, `in`, a discriminator field, or `zod` / equivalent).
67:   - Third-party type is wrong → augment via `declare module` in a local `.d.ts`, not `any`.
68:   - Truly dynamic case (e.g. generic event bus) → use a generic `<T>` with a constraint, not `any`.
69: - `unknown` + narrowing is the acceptable escape hatch. `any` is not.
70: - If you genuinely cannot avoid `any` for a specific line (extremely rare), leave a one-line comment with **why** and **what would remove it**, so reviewers can audit.
71: - The same spirit applies to ESLint: do not sprinkle `// eslint-disable` to mute the real signal. Fix the rule violation, or discuss before disabling.

13: - **Auth flows** — sign in, sign up, logout, session guards, token refresh, `getSession`
14: - **Async UI** — loading spinners, skeletons, error banners, retry buttons, streaming responses
15: - **Conditional rendering** — empty states, permission-gated sections, feature flags
16: - **Third-party SDK calls from the browser** — CloudBase Web SDK (auth, database, AI model, storage), analytics, payment

10: ## Next.js
11: 
12: ### SDK boundary
13: 
14: `@cloudbase/js-sdk` is a **browser-only** SDK. It must not be imported in Server Components, `getServerSideProps`, or API Routes.
15: 
16: - Auth flows (sign in, sign up, session check) → **Client Component only** (`"use client"`)
17: - API Routes / Route Handlers → use `@cloudbase/node-sdk` (Node.js SDK) for server-side token verification
18: - Server Components → read tokens from cookies/headers, do NOT import `@cloudbase/js-sdk`
19: 
20: ### Auth pattern (App Router)
21: 
22: ```tsx
23: // components/auth-guard.tsx — Client Component
24: "use client"
25: 
26: import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
27: import cloudbase from "@cloudbase/js-sdk"
28: 
29: const app = cloudbase.init({
30:   env: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDBASE_ENV_ID!,
31:   region: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDBASE_REGION || "ap-shanghai",
32:   accessKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDBASE_ACCESS_KEY!,
33:   auth: { detectSessionInUrl: true },
34: })
35: const auth = app.auth
36: 
37: export function AuthGuard({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
38:   const [session, setSession] = useState<any>(null)
39:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
40: 
41:   useEffect(() => {
42:     auth.getSession().then(({ data }) => {
43:       if (data?.session) {
44:         setSession(data.session)
45:         // Store access_token in cookie for API route verification
46:         document.cookie = `cloudbase_token=${data.session.access_token}; path=/; max-age=3600`
47:       }
48:       setLoading(false)
49:     })
50:   }, [])
51: 
52:   if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>
53:   if (!session) return <div>Please sign in</div>
54:   return <>{children}</>
55: }
56: ```
57: 
58: ### Passing auth to API Routes
59: 
60: ```tsx
61: // app/api/protected/route.ts — Server-side Route Handler
62: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server"
63: 
64: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
65:   const token = request.cookies.get("cloudbase_token")?.value
66:   if (!token) {
67:     return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 })
68:   }
69:   // Verify token with Node SDK or forward to your backend
70:   return NextResponse.json({ data: "protected resource" })
71: }
72: ```

76: - Build output: `next build` → `.next` directory
77: - CloudBase static hosting expects `package.json` with build scripts and the output directory configured; prefer `manageApps` for deployment
78: - If deploying via `manageHosting`, set error document to `index.html` for client-side routing (even though Next.js defaults to file-based routing, fallback handling is needed for SPA-like paths)

96: import { Module, Global } from "@nestjs/common"
97: import tcb from "@cloudbase/node-sdk"
98: 
99: export const CLOUDBASE = "CLOUDBASE"
100: 
101: const cloudbaseProvider = {
102:   provide: CLOUDBASE,
103:   useFactory: () => {
104:     const app = tcb.init({
105:       env: process.env.CLOUDBASE_ENV_ID!,
106:       // credentials: require("/path/to/tcb_custom_login.json"), // only for custom login
107:     })
108:     return {
109:       app,

112:     }
113:   },
114: }

116: @Global()
117: @Module({
118:   providers: [cloudbaseProvider],
119:   exports: [cloudbaseProvider],
120: })
121: export class CloudBaseModule {}
122: ```

143:       // forward the token to a cloud function or use the HTTP API for validation
